newsitem.title: USA: Elan/Axogen stake held by Farallon group.
newsitem.headline: Elan/Axogen stake held by Farallon group.

text.p: A group led by Farallon Capital Management LLC said Monday it holds 6.1 percent or 280,000 units of securities jointly offered by Elan Corp Plc and Axogen Ltd in November.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the units in an initial public offering at $18 per unit.

Each unit consists of one common share of Axogen and one warrant to acquire an Elan American Depository Share, the filing said. Farallon, a San Francisco investment advisory group, said it acquired the securities for investment purposes.

The units are currently listed on the American Stock Exchange and will trade under Axogen's stock symbol until December 31, 1998. Thereafter, Axogen common shares and Elan warrants will trade separately.

Elan Corp, is a Dublin, Ireland world-wide drug delivery and biopharmaceutical company. Axogen was formed in September 1996 and has an agreement with Elan to develop therapeutic products for treatment of neurological disorders.
